Section 2.02 All employees covered by this Agreement who are members of the Union on the effective date of this Agreement shall, as a condition of employment, maintain their membership in the Union during the term of this Agreement. All present employees not members of the Union shall be required to become members of the Union on the 30th day after the effective date of this Agreement. New employees hired after the effective date of this Agreement shall be required to become members of the Union on the 30th day after beginning employment.
